name: Paris
blurb: Boulevards, world-class museums and the food that started it all.

name: London
blurb: Free national museums, endless theatre and a pub on every corner.

name: Rome
blurb: Two thousand years of ruins, and the espresso is still a euro.

name: Tokyo
blurb: Neon districts, silent shrines and the best cheap food anywhere.

name: New York City
blurb: Five boroughs that never quite stop moving.

name: Barcelona
blurb: Gaudi, beaches and dinner that starts at ten.

name: Amsterdam
blurb: Canal rings, Golden Age painting and bikes with right of way.

name: Istanbul
blurb: Two continents, one ferry ride, and bazaars older than most countries.

name: Bangkok
blurb: Street food capital of the world, and it barely costs anything.

name: Berlin
blurb: Cold War history, cheap rent energy and clubs that open at dawn.

name: Prague
blurb: A gothic old town that survived the twentieth century intact.

name: Lisbon
blurb: Seven hills, tiled facades and Atlantic light.

name: Vienna
blurb: Imperial palaces, coffee houses and the world's best public transport.

name: Budapest
blurb: Thermal baths, ruin bars and a river that splits two old cities.

name: Madrid
blurb: The Prado, late nights and the best tapas crawl in Iberia.

name: Athens
blurb: The Acropolis above a scruffy, brilliant modern city.

name: Dubai
blurb: Desert, skyline and a stopover that turned into a destination.

name: Singapore
blurb: Hawker centres with Michelin stars and a city inside a garden.

name: Hong Kong
blurb: Harbour skyline, mountain trails and dim sum at every hour.

name: Seoul
blurb: Palaces, night markets and mountains inside the city limits.

name: Kyoto
blurb: A thousand temples and the last of old Japan.

name: Osaka
blurb: Japan's kitchen: loud, friendly and built around eating.

name: Hanoi
blurb: Old quarter chaos, lake mornings and coffee with egg in it.

name: Ho Chi Minh City
blurb: Motorbike rivers, war history and food on every kerb.

name: Hoi An
blurb: Lantern-lit riverfront, tailors and a beach twenty minutes away.

name: Chiang Mai
blurb: Moated old city, mountain temples and northern Thai cooking.

name: Kuala Lumpur
blurb: Towers, colonial arcades and three cuisines on one street.

name: Denpasar
blurb: The gateway to Bali: temples, terraces and surf.

name: Phnom Penh
blurb: Riverfront capital with a difficult, essential recent history.

name: Siem Reap
blurb: Base camp for Angkor, the largest religious monument on earth.

name: Luang Prabang
blurb: Mekong monasteries and a town that goes quiet after dark.

name: Kathmandu
blurb: Temple squares, trekking permits and the Himalaya on the horizon.

name: Pokhara
blurb: Lakeside town under the Annapurnas, and where treks begin.

name: New Delhi
blurb: Mughal tombs, Lutyens avenues and the loudest markets in India.

name: Mumbai
blurb: Art deco seafront, film industry and street food worth the trip.

name: Jaipur
blurb: Pink city forts, stepwells and block-printed everything.

name: Udaipur
blurb: Lake palaces and the most photographed rooftops in Rajasthan.

name: Colombo
blurb: Colonial fort district, sea breeze and very good curry.

name: Cairo
blurb: The pyramids on the city edge and a museum full of pharaohs.

name: Marrakesh
blurb: Medina alleys, riad courtyards and the Atlas within reach.

name: Cape Town
blurb: A mountain in the middle of the city and wine country next door.

name: Nairobi
blurb: The only capital with a national park inside its boundary.

name: Zurich
blurb: Lake, old town and the highest prices in Europe.

name: Geneva
blurb: Diplomatic lakefront with the Alps an hour away.

name: Copenhagen
blurb: Design, bicycles and the restaurant scene that reset Nordic food.

name: Oslo
blurb: Fjord city, Viking ships and the gateway north.

name: Stockholm
blurb: Fourteen islands, a preserved old town and very good coffee.

name: Reykjavik
blurb: Tiny capital, enormous landscape starting at the ring road.

name: Dublin
blurb: Literary pubs, Georgian doors and the coast on the DART line.

name: Edinburgh
blurb: A castle on a volcano and the world's biggest arts festival.

name: Krakow
blurb: Intact medieval square, Jewish quarter and sobering day trips.

name: Dubrovnik
blurb: Walled Adriatic city you can walk the ramparts of.

name: Split
blurb: A Roman palace that became a town, plus the island ferries.

name: Porto
blurb: River gorge, port cellars and tiles by the acre.

name: Seville
blurb: Moorish palaces, orange trees and flamenco that is not for tourists.

name: Florence
blurb: The Renaissance at walking scale.

name: Venice
blurb: No cars, no logic, and nowhere else like it.

name: Munich
blurb: Beer halls, Bavarian museums and the Alps ninety minutes south.

name: Tel Aviv-Yafo
blurb: Bauhaus blocks, Mediterranean beach and a very late night.

name: Amman
blurb: Hilltop capital and the base for Petra and Wadi Rum.

name: Mexico City
blurb: Aztec ruins under a colonial grid, and the best tacos on earth.

name: Oaxaca
blurb: Mole, mezcal and the strongest craft tradition in Mexico.

name: Havana
blurb: Crumbling grandeur, live son and cars from another century.

name: Cartagena
blurb: Walled Caribbean city in impossible colours.

name: Bogotá
blurb: High-altitude capital with gold museums and serious coffee.

name: Lima
blurb: Cliffs over the Pacific and one of the world's great food cities.

name: Cusco
blurb: Inca walls under colonial arches, and the road to Machu Picchu.

name: Buenos Aires
blurb: European bones, Argentine appetite, tango after midnight.

name: Rio de Janeiro
blurb: Beaches between mountains, and a city that treats them as a commons.

name: São Paulo
blurb: Endless, immigrant-built and the best restaurants in the hemisphere.

name: Santiago
blurb: Andes on the skyline, vineyards in every direction.

name: Toronto
blurb: The most multicultural city anywhere, and it shows up on the menu.

name: Montréal
blurb: French North America, bagels and a festival every week of summer.

name: Vancouver
blurb: Ocean, mountains and rainforest inside the city limits.

name: San Francisco
blurb: Fog, hills and the bay that made the last fifty years.

name: Chicago
blurb: The birthplace of the skyscraper, on a freshwater sea.

name: New Orleans
blurb: Creole cooking, brass bands and the only US city like it.

name: Los Angeles
blurb: Beaches, canyons, museums and eighty miles of sprawl between them.

name: Sydney
blurb: The harbour, the coastal walk and surf on a weekday morning.

name: Melbourne
blurb: Laneway coffee, street art and Australia's arts capital.

name: Auckland
blurb: Volcanoes, two harbours and the jumping-off point for the north.
